title: Temple Facilities
content: Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha provides various facilities for the convenience of devotees and visitors.

facilities.name: Wheelchair Access
facilities.description: Wheelchair access available at the main entrance with ramps

facilities.name: Drinking Water
facilities.description: RO purified water available near the entrance and Annadanam hall

facilities.name: Restrooms
facilities.description: Clean restrooms available near the entrance and parking area

facilities.name: Parking
facilities.description: Free parking available at main entrance and east entrance

facilities.name: Annadanam Hall
facilities.description: Free meals served daily to devotees

facilities.name: Guest House
facilities.description: Accommodation available for devotees. Contact office for booking

facilities.name: Prasada Counter
facilities.description: Prasada available at counter near exit after darshan
